title: Barcoded Calling Cards and Transcriptomes: Library Preparation
author: Matthew Lalli
materials: NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean-up kit
The tagmentation protocol fragments the long PCR products into libraries suitable for sequencing. Preheat thermocycler to 55 °C
In parallel with Calling Card libraries, prepare BRB-seq libaries with tagmentation. Preheat thermocycler to 55 °C

steps.title: Harvest cells and split if needed
steps.instruction: Harvest cells; do not overload Zymo‑Spin IICR columns. If the cell count exceeds 1 × 10⁷, split the lysate equally onto two columns, process separately, and later merge the RNA eluates.

steps.title: Lyse cells with TRI Reagent
steps.instruction: Add TRI Reagent directly to the cells in the dish. Use 300 µL for up to 1 × 10⁷ cells or 600 µL for larger numbers (see the provided table). Lyse the cells and transfer the lysate to a 1.7 mL tube.

steps.title: Add ethanol and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 95‑100 % ethanol to the lysate and vortex briefly to homogenize.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Zymo‑Spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL of the lysate‑ethanol mixture to a Zymo‑Spin IICR column placed in a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge ≥ 8,000 g for 30 s. If the sample volume exceeds 700 µL, repeat the transfer and centrifugation until all lysate has passed through. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Pre‑wash column
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL RNA PreWash buffer to the column, centrifuge (≥ 8,000 g, 30 s), and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with RNA Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge briefly, discard the flow‑through, then centrifuge for 2 min. Transfer the column to a new RNase‑free tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL DNase/RNase‑free water (or TE buffer) directly onto the column membrane and centrifuge to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer or Qubit fluorometer.

steps.title: Prepare RT master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample combine: 2 µg total RNA, 2 µL of 25 µM BRB‑seq_dT30VN primer (e.g., pSeq1‑BC1‑UMI‑dtVN), 1 µL of 10 mM dNTPs, and ddH₂O to a total volume of 14 µL. Incubate at 65 °C for 5 min, then place on ice for 1 min.

steps.title: Make 1× Maxima RT buffer
steps.instruction: For up to five samples, mix 1 µL 5× Maxima RT buffer with 4 µL ddH₂O. Keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare 0.5× enzyme dilution
steps.instruction: Mix equal volumes of Maxima RT H Minus Enzyme and the 1× Maxima RT buffer prepared above (e.g., 2 µL enzyme + 2 µL buffer). Use 1 µL of this 0.5× dilution per RT reaction; avoid pipetting volumes < 1 µL.

steps.title: Assemble and run RT reaction
steps.instruction: To each 14 µL RT mix add 4 µL 5× Maxima RT Buffer, 1 µL RNasin RNase Inhibitor, 1 µL 0.5× Maxima RT H Minus enzyme, and 1 µL 25 µM SMART_TSO. Mix gently and incubate at 50 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate reverse transcriptase
steps.instruction: Incubate the RT reaction at 85 °C for 10 min to inactivate the enzyme.

steps.title: Purify cDNA with NucleoSpin kit
steps.instruction: Column‑purify the cDNA using the NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean‑up kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol. If pooling samples, combine 3–5 µL of each cDNA, bring the volume to 100 µL with water, add 200 µL NT1 buffer, and proceed with the kit. Elute in 30–50 µL DNase/RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Store cDNA
steps.instruction: Store purified cDNA at –20 °C for long‑term storage or at 4 °C if it will be used within a short time.

steps.title: Set up SRT PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare the following PCR mix per reaction: 25 µL 2× Kapa HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, 1 µL 25 µM reverse primer (partial seq1), 4 µL purified cDNA, 19 µL ddH₂O, and 1 µL 25 µM forward primer (either 25 µM SRT_PAC_F1 for PB‑SRT‑Puro or 25 µM SRT_tdTomato_F1 for PB‑SRT‑tdTomato).

steps.title: Run SRT PCR
steps.instruction: Thermocycle: 95 °C 3 min; 20 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 65 °C 30 s, 72 °C 5 min; 72 °C 10 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: First AMPure XP cleanup (0.6×)
steps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads to resuspend and let them equilibrate at room temperature for ≥ 30 min. Add 30 µL beads to each 50 µL PCR (0.6×). Mix by pipetting 10 times, incubate 5 min at RT, place on a magnetic rack 2 min, and discard supernatant. Wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol (≥ 30 s each), then air‑dry beads 2 min (do not over‑dry). Elute DNA with 20 µL ddH₂O, mix, incubate 2 min off the rack, place on magnetic rack 1 min, and transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Quantify PCR product
steps.instruction: Measure the purified product on a TapeStation D5000. Expected concentration 10–20 ng/µL; size distribution 400 bp–9 kb for SRTs and full transcriptomes.

steps.title: Prepare tagmentation input
steps.instruction: Take 1 ng of the PCR product and resuspend in a total of 5 µL ddH₂O in a PCR strip tube (input range 600 pg–1.2 ng).

steps.title: Tagment DNA
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Nextera Tagment DNA (TD) Buffer and 5 µL Amplicon Tagment Mix (ATM) to the 5 µL DNA, mix, and incubate at 55 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Neutralize tagmentation
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL Neutralization Tagment (NT) Buffer, mix, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Add Nextera PCR mix for SRT
steps.instruction: Add to each tube (in order): 15 µL Nextera PCR Mix (NPM), 8 µL ddH₂O, 1 µL 10 µM barcoded piggyBac primer (e.g., P5_BC_SRT_STAGGER1), and 1 µL 10 µM indexed Nextera N7 primer (e.g., Nextera_N701).

steps.title: Amplify tagmented SRT library
steps.instruction: Thermocycle: 72 °C 3 min; 95 °C 30 s; 16 cycles of 95 °C 10 s, 52 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; 72 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Second AMPure XP cleanup (0.7×)
steps.instruction: Vortex beads, let equilibrate ≥ 30 min at RT. Add 35 µL beads to each 50 µL PCR (0.7×), mix 10 times, incubate 5 min at RT, place on magnetic rack 2 min, discard supernatant. Wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol (≥ 30 s each), air‑dry 2 min (do not over‑dry). Elute with 11 µL ddH₂O, mix, incubate 2 min off the rack, place on magnetic rack 1 min, and transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Measure final library
steps.instruction: Quantify the purified library on a TapeStation High Sensitivity D1000 ScreenTape. Expected size 300–600 bp; concentration 2–4 ng/µL.

steps.title: Optional full‑length transcriptome PCR
steps.instruction: If desired, amplify full‑length transcriptomes from cDNA. Prepare a PCR mix: 25 µL 2× Kapa HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, 1 µL 25 µM reverse primer (partial seq1), 1 µL 25 µM forward primer (SMART), 4 µL pooled purified cDNA, 19 µL ddH₂O.

steps.title: Run optional transcriptome PCR
steps.instruction: Thermocycle: 95 °C 3 min; 10 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 6 min; 72 °C 10 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Optional second PCR for transcriptomes
steps.instruction: Thermocycle: 72 °C 3 min; 95 °C 30 s; 16 cycles of 95 °C 10 s, 55 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; 72 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: BRB‑seq library amplification
steps.instruction: For each tube add: 15 µL Nextera PCR Mix (NPM), 8 µL ddH₂O, 1 µL 10 µM P5‑index‑seq1 primer, and 1 µL 10 µM indexed Nextera N7 primer. Then add 5 µL Neutralization Tagment (NT) Buffer, incubate 5 min at RT, add 10 µL TD Buffer and 5 µL ATM, mix, and incubate 55 °C for 5 min. Finally, take 1 ng of the PCR product and resuspend in 5 µL ddH₂O before proceeding to bead cleanup as described above.
